answer: One concrete mechanism: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because sable only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, vault is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any tide approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
